issues: Sales missed target by £140, inside the 0.3% band accepted as hitting target, and delivery and site wide metrics were positive for the first time since August (EDI/NEW KPI meeting 24/11 and M3 GM/HC notes 16/11 to 22/11).
Year on year sales were down £3,199.92 (8.1%); spend per head and covers were slightly down week on week but up year on year, and sushi hit its sales mix target for the first time since August.
Wages were 23.1%, just missing the labour target, while food cost and stock were both within range.

All 11 Google reviews were 5 star, but the site still cannot reply to reviews since the Google account ownership change, which also deleted the year's review responses; Ross is waiting on Google to restore access.
The new boiler broke down last week and keeps cutting out at about 50 degrees because the ignition does not detect a flame; it is still under warranty.
Deliveroo prep time still needs to come down, and the site asked whether Matt Polak came in to fix the ramen wait times.
Weekly hygiene compliance was 100%, an electrician is due to fix loose switches behind the fryers, and pest control, fire, electrical, gas and ventilation are up to date.
BOH cover is changing as one chef goes away for four months and a returning team member needs 20 hours of retraining, and a FOH team member was promoted to Assistant General Manager.
Christmas hours: closing at 8pm on 24/12 and 31/12 and closed on 25/12, with 26/12 and New Year's Day to be confirmed.
